pattern: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.
criterion: Do not state an unverified claim as a fact.

lesson.title: Verify promotion expiration before confirming date
lesson.when: A customer asks to confirm a specific expiration date for a discount code or promotion, and retrieved results show the applied discount but omit its end date.
lesson.do: State only the verified discount details present in official results and clearly express uncertainty regarding the exact expiration date.
lesson.otherwise: State an unverified promotion expiration date or promise that an offer lasts until a specific day.
